responsibility: This file implements mc’s lightweight heterogeneous argument package by copying up to four raw byte-array operands into one owned buffer and recording per-argument offsets and lengths. It supports sequential extraction, repositioning, in-place replacement, cloning, and cleanup, and is primarily used by mcMetaError to feed nodes, names, and cardinals through its template-expansion engine without relying on language-level variadic calls.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for the vararg wrapper, defining the internal record, packed contents buffer, argument descriptors, and copy/replace/extraction code. Unlike varargs.def, it contains the concrete representation and procedure bodies rather than only the exported declarations.
